The '''Refrax spaceport''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Refrax]] that served as a stop-over point for ships traveling through [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
